notes.note: Reviewed the final type-only queue correction against the actual mutation implementations and shared controls. Reorder and merge already accept conversationId at runtime; their public interface now declares it. The queueScope return type preserves the optional Station/conversation tuple and the unbound host call shape. The mounted peer fixture now supplies the required isCurrent scope callback. No dispatch, persistence, delivery, authority, or rendered behavior changed. Existing owning-Station and conversation explanations remain accurate; no prose update or MCP regeneration is needed. The mounted real-queue regression passed all five cases (20.10 seconds); UI typecheck passed after correcting the signatures. These checks do not qualify native shells or physical providers.
